name: Kusaka Ayame
source:
Her looks are intimidating to the point that other students refer to her as "The Overlord". Since she loves cute things, she becomes excited whenever she sees something she finds adorable.  [url=/c98550]Hikaru[/url] is her childhood friend. Ayame values the few people who she can speak freely with as her precious friends.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180927080054/http://kimisaki.happyelements.co.jp/charactor/]archived official website[/url]]
